scope: Held final-Qwen probe inputs; independent current=old closed form in FP32/FP64 plus direct existing CPU kernel. This is a precision audit, not another accelerator attempt or a parameter-gradient campaign.
interpretation: The held quantized heads replay within 2.6e-9 under an independent FP32 current=old formula. FP64 evaluation differs by up to 0.002755 in the artificial temperature 0.7 warmup with 21 valid positions, all in the tail-floor regime. Reusing the FP32 modeled-tail coefficient in otherwise-FP64 arithmetic reduces that discrepancy below 1.6e-8, locating sensitivity in the tiny estimated tail. This is a scalar-precision limit of the preserved kernel; parameter-gradient impact is not established. No numeric tolerance, floor, kernel or K was changed.
